raw coordinates and opaque topology did not establish an accuracy benefit

studyClass.reason: The design is frozen before external corpus labels, packets, model responses, or outcomes are available. Creating this protocol does not satisfy the confirmation gates.

eligibility: codebase is not HoloScript, ai-ecosystem, Hololand, or a repository used to design v1 through v3
codebase has a machine-verifiable commit hash and a license permitting research analysis
codebase contains at least 500 tracked source files and more than one internal module boundary
no benchmark author may inspect model outcomes before the corpus and protocol receipt are sealed

annotation.agreementMetric: Krippendorff alpha over binary file relevance

arms.description: Question plus compact candidate cards containing aliases, normalized paths, and at most four symbol names.
The text arm plus the label-blind v3 relational projection.
The text arm plus a deterministic rendered graph image delivered as actual image bytes to a vision-capable agent.
The relational arm plus the identical deterministic rendered graph image.

design.candidateConstruction: For controlled navigation, include every independently annotated relevant file, then fill with label-blind HoloEmbed hard negatives that resolve to canonical CodebaseSceneCompiler nodes.
design.candidateScopeBoundary: Every relevant file is inserted into the candidate set. This study measures selection and ranking from a bounded view, not end-to-end retrieval recall.
design.counterbalancing: Generate one deterministic candidate permutation per query, rotate it across arms with a query-derived offset, and independently rotate arm request order by trial.
design.promptInjectionBoundary: Raw source bodies, doc comments, signatures, gold candidate IDs, relevance labels, and prior outcomes are excluded from all prompts.

visualProjection.edgeLabels: typed legend plus color and arrow direction
visualProjection.accessibilityAltText: Graph image with candidate aliases only; it must not enumerate edges or communities in prose.

responseSchema.rankedCandidateIds: array of one to five unique candidate aliases in descending relevance order

claimBoundary.measuredSurface: none until an admitted v4 run supplies actual image bytes and passes all custody gates
claimBoundary.reason: This file freezes the external confirmatory design only. No external corpus, independent annotations, rendered packets, multimodal responses, or results exist yet.
claimBoundary.allowedCurrentClaim: HoloAbsorb has a preregistered external multi-codebase factorial protocol designed to isolate the incremental effect of literal graph pixels from structured relational text.
